contexts.text: All the arcana of... physics, etc. are inscribed on (the human body).
They believed that influx is physical and not spiritual. Explained.
Physical influx is contrary to order... thus impossible. AC 9401:2. AC 9419:end. AC 10199:2. AC 10299:3. DLW 166:end. ISB 1. ISB 19. TCR 695:3. SE 5686. AE 1215:end.
By the sciences are meant physics, etc.
Demonstrate that three are one by various things in physics, etc.
Among them were many skilled in the physical art.
(Argument) that influx is from nature, or physical.
Concerning those who want to enter into Divine mysteries by natural philosophy, or physical things.
He had studied instrumental causes only, ... as physics, etc.
The useful sciences are physics, etc. DMin 4657.
This order is called physical or natural influx, which is quite impossible in heavenly things.
